medium_statement: Soft gouache/airbrush digital illustration for a Muslim wedding portrait: mostly flat-to-gently-shaded color fields with a diffused, brush-blended cloud texture in the sky and background elements, rendered by a hand that favors soft edges over crisp vector boundaries.
line: Thin, confident, fully closed ink outlines used only on facial features and fine details (glasses, hijab edge); clothing, sky and floral shapes carry no outline at all and rely on flat color edges instead.

fill.description: Soft, semi-transparent pigment bleeding at edges — visible in the sky's cloud transitions and border roses' hazy diffusion. Skin and clothing keep smoother, opaque coverage with gentle blended shading, never a hard cel edge.

texture: Fine, even brush-grain across sky and cloud passages, like soft airbrush spatter with visible directional strokes; smooth and grain-free on skin and gown fabric.

palette.role: warm ivory cream — bridal gown, hijab, cream rose petals
warm peach — skin tone, coral bouquet accents
deep espresso brown — groom's hair and suit shading
hazy dusty blue-grey — soft-focus border rose petals
warm beige — lace and gown highlight, skin undertone
muted sage-olive — bouquet stems and foliage

forbidden: hard black outline on clothing, sky or objects (outline reserved for facial features only)
crisp flat vector fill with no blending
notes: Pinterest Muslim-wedding reference. Classic-family (flow+overlay), PRO tier, slug rose-horizon (Template11). Two decorative systems beyond section content, tracked in the design brief, not this schema: (1) rose-border frame per section via SectionOverlay, (2) one tileable vertical 'flow background' behind all sections, parallax-scrolled. This spec covers rendering only; scene-level geometry for those two lives outside scene.json's Stage-family vocabulary.
